scope: Selected SQLite 3.46.1 findCreateFileMode, databaseName, URI first-match lookup and boolean conversion; one private issuer owns the immutable filename allocation. This component does not perform unixOpen, physical stat or Store publication.

boundary.HIA_signature: readbuf source, mutbuf output, mutbuf workspace -> u32

source_qwords: issuer context nonce, not external authentication
action (0 at BEGIN, 1 for completed STAT reply)
logical filename pointer offset in immutable allocation
source_tail: BEGIN: complete filename allocation then key bytes without NUL. REPLY: complete actual FS result, exactly 256 error bytes or 400 success bytes; all BEGIN-only fields in reply must be zero as defined by cm_ack_shape.

phases.fresh0: Requires a fully zero 1024-byte workspace; validate source header and private bounded ranges before interpreting selected operation.
phases.prepared1: Stores the exact BEGIN header and derived value/path offsets. GROW does not increment either FS counter or publish a stat request. Same original immutable source lease is required on retry; complete header is checked.
phases.waiting2: Exactly one selected path was published to FS8 opcode29 STAT_CSTR. Completed reply must match context, call, action, operation29, actual extent, FS result state/version, reserved fields and all duplicated struct-stat fields before commit.
phases.complete3: No further request or reply is admitted; repeated calls permanently reject.
phases.bad: First reason retained; every later invocation rejects when the workspace can hold the BAD marker. A shorter-than8-byte workspace has no persistent marker capacity and is reported only as a local refusal.

original_semantics: WAL/MAIN_JOURNAL priority precedes DELETEONCLOSE and URI. Scan backward until '-' (only at index>0) or '.'; a '.' encountered first suppresses stat. DELETEONCLOSE produces0600 without stat.
URI modeof uses exact case-sensitive first key match. Empty modeof is a present empty C pathname and must issue raw stat, preserving actual ENOENT or any other raw result.
databaseName scans backward for four zero bytes in the same valid private allocation. URI key and value traversal preserves sqlite3Strlen30's 30-bit count mask.

GetBoolean inspects the first byte for an ASCII digit. sqlite3GetInt32 prefix handling, optional0x integer, leading zeros and signed-int maximum are preserved. Numeric conversion is then truncated to u8 before nonzero;256 is false.
Nondigit strings use exact case-insensitive on/no/off/false/yes/true lengths; extra/full and signed or whitespace-prefixed values retain normalized default.
Successful stat preserves incoming errno; failure produces SQLITE_IOERR_FSTAT1802 and exact errno with mode/uid/gid still0.

FS8.name: STAT_CSTR
FS8.difference: Same op18 raw stat continuation and duplicate-field checks; only new op29 additionally accepts empty C pathname. Old operations1..28 unchanged.

custody.C_oracle_domain: Only bounded cases whose C filename pointers and terminators are valid. Malformed private frames are checked by VM/native only, never passed to undefined C pointer reads.

validation_plan.complete_buffers: Every VM/native invocation compares return, whole output, whole workspace, immutable source and canaries, without masks.
